sentences.text: Tiaraspis was a member of the class Placodermi, an extinct group of armored fish.
This animal is classified within the family Holonematidae.
The species of the genus Tiaraspis is named subtilis.
The species Tiaraspis subtilis was described by Gross in 1933.
The genus Tiaraspis was established by Gross in 1962.
Fossils of the species Tiaraspis subtilis have been found in Germany dating from the Pragian to the Emsian epochs of the Early Devonian.
The creature lived between 419.62 and 393.47 million years ago, spanning the Lochkovian to Emsian stages.
